data.title: Fake OTA Domain Pattern Detection — Domains Mimicking Booking.com/Expedia/Airbnb Registered < 30 Days
data.description: Detects web traffic to recently registered domains (< 30 days old) that mimic major Online Travel Agency brands (Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb) using typosquatting, homoglyph substitution, or brand-adjacent naming patterns. These fake OTA domains are the primary infrastructure for travel booking fraud credential harvesting operations. NordVPN/Saily identified 4,344 active fake travel domains in 2026. Average domain lifespan is 18 days before takedown, making registration age the highest-signal detection feature. Domains serving payment form pages are critical-severity indicators.

detection.condition: selection_domain_patterns and not filter_legitimate and filter_domain_age

enrichment_required.source: Domain WHOIS or passive DNS enrichment providing domain registration date

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Fake OTA Domain Pattern Detection — DL-0180")`
`comment("Detects access to recently registered domains mimicking major OTA brands")`
index=flame_proxy sourcetype=flame:web_traffic
| rex field=request_domain "(?i)(?<brand_match>book[1i!l]ng|b00king|exped[1i!l]a|exp3dia|a[1i!l]rbnb|airbnb)"
| where isnotnull(brand_match)
| lookup domain_whois_enrichment request_domain OUTPUT domain_registration_date, domain_age_days
| where domain_age_days < 30
| eval is_payment_page = if(match(request_url, "(?i)(payment|checkout|pay|billing|card|credit)"), 1, 0)
| eval risk_score = case(
    is_payment_page=1 AND domain_age_days < 7, "critical",
    is_payment_page=1, "high",
    domain_age_days < 7, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| stats count as request_count,
        dc(source_ip) as unique_visitors,
        values(request_url) as urls,
        max(is_payment_page) as has_payment_page
  by request_domain, domain_registration_date, domain_age_days, risk_score
| sort - request_count
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Fake OTA Domain Pattern Detection
SELECT
  w.request_domain,
  d.domain_registration_date,
  DATEDIFF(DAY, d.domain_registration_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS domain_age_days,
  COUNT(*) AS request_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.source_ip) AS unique_visitors,
  MAX(CASE WHEN w.request_url LIKE '%payment%' OR w.request_url LIKE '%checkout%'
           OR w.request_url LIKE '%billing%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_payment_page
FROM web_traffic_logs w
JOIN domain_whois d ON w.request_domain = d.domain_name
WHERE (w.request_domain LIKE '%book_ng%' OR w.request_domain LIKE '%b00king%'
       OR w.request_domain LIKE '%exped_a%' OR w.request_domain LIKE '%airbnb%'
       OR w.request_domain LIKE '%a_rbnb%')
  AND w.request_domain NOT IN ('booking.com', 'expedia.com', 'airbnb.com',
                                'hotels.com')
  AND w.request_domain NOT LIKE '%.booking.com'
  AND w.request_domain NOT LIKE '%.expedia.com'
  AND w.request_domain NOT LIKE '%.airbnb.com'
  AND DATEDIFF(DAY, d.domain_registration_date, CURRENT_DATE) < 30
GROUP BY w.request_domain, d.domain_registration_date
ORDER BY request_count DESC

references: Sumsub, Travel Fraud: The Hidden Epidemic (2026)
Riskified, OTA Fraud Patterns and Detection Strategies
falsepositives: Legitimate new travel startups with names similar to established OTA brands
Regional OTA affiliates or partner sites with brand-adjacent domains
Travel deal aggregator sites with recently registered domains
Marketing campaign microsites operated by legitimate OTA brands
